controls.evidence: Canonical authority stores only an opaque token, tenant-bound keyed fingerprint, last four and key version. The supported-upgrade migration encrypts a populated legacy row using an injected ephemeral key, verifies round-trip conversion and drops account_id_value in the same transaction.
controls.exitGate: Clean and populated supported-upgrade paths contain no clear identifier column; the migration fails closed without a sufficiently strong injected key.

controls.evidence: Disclosure snapshots remain masked and live probes scan snapshot, outbox, audit and command evidence for the historical raw marker after retrieval and rotation.
controls.exitGate: Both certification reports contain a passing ordinary-evidence leakage-negative probe.

controls.evidence: A SECURITY DEFINER retrieval command requires the dedicated NOLOGIN broker role, exact recipient, active governed purpose, active disclosure, current version and an active payments capability. Immutable evidence and an audit event are committed atomically.

controls.evidence: The rotation command requires a monotonically incremented key version, records token hashes only, replaces the old token atomically and rejects direct mutation. No old token is retained outside immutable hash evidence.
controls.exitGate: Rotation, exact replay, stale/direct mutation and crypto-shredding probes pass.

controls.evidence: Settlement and refund directions, required payments capability and retrieval TTL are governed by a reference-safe active catalog used by bank links, disclosures and retrieval.
controls.exitGate: Hard-coded trigger branching is replaced and purpose references use restrictive FKs.

controls.exitGate: No-first-writer, maker-checker and atomic accepted resolution probes pass.
